candidate.title: PD-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned PD-Seq row under the Protein-Protein Interactions heading. Two preparation branches (bead immobilization and RNA-derived phage library construction) converge on repeated binding selection and PCR of phage inserts, ending in DNA. The left Protein target line and PD-Seq identifies candidate cellular targets for proteins caption are explanatory target illustrations, not a DNA input connected to bead synthesis. Chem-seq above and ProP-PD / PDZ-Seq below are neighboring rows, not alternative targets of this assigned card. The paper-associated implementation concerns apigenin-binding proteins; diagram labels are preserved and their overgeneralized protein-bait interpretation is corrected explicitly.

operations.label: Hybridize / Wash / Repeat cycle three times
operations.description: Converges the independent bait-support and phage-library preparations. Hybridize denotes association of displayed library proteins with immobilized bait. operations.mechanism: Affinity selection of displayed proteins against bead-immobilized bait; Hybridize is interpreted here as binding, not nucleic-acid base pairing.
operations.information_effect: Enriches the encoding inserts of candidate bait-binding proteins through retention of their display phages.
